skill.summary: Turn three product images and a voiceover MP3 into 1080p ready-to-upload videos just by typing what you need. Whether it's generating polished YouTube videos...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI YouTube Video Maker 1.0.0 — Initial release.

- Instantly turns images and a voiceover into 1080p YouTube-ready videos using AI, with no need for local software.
- Drag and drop video clips or images, describe your desired result, and get a downloadable MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles session and token setup automatically, with up to 100 free cloud processing credits.
- Supports export, timeline status, credit queries, and guides users through uploading and editing flows.
- Accepts major video, image, and audio formats; optimized for fast, concise video creation and export.
